designer_intent.overall_goal: Create a cinematic Boom Bap instrumental with dark mood and expressive energy flow using contemporary sample slicing techniques.

melody_generator.brief: Produce sparse, haunting melodic chop phrases to underscore the cinematic vibe.

ai_designer.brief: Arrange and balance all track elements ensuring a dynamic cinematic rise and fall.

presetor.brief: Apply and tweak audio presets to enhance Boom Bap character and cinematic texture.

songgps.brief: Manage energy curve and section transitions reflecting cinematic mood and arrangement plan.
